note: P4306 (Pro 27:20) — Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied, and neither are the eyes of man.

dims.v: unsatisfied craving — the eyes of man that never have enough
the never-satisfied eyes of man, insatiable as Sheol and Abaddon that are never full — the restless craving of desire that no amount of getting ever contents
(the grave's insatiability it is likened to)
the human craving that, like death, is never filled

saba (be satisfied), negated — 'never satisfied are the EYES of man'; human desire is bottomless as the grave, never content with what it has (cf 30:15-16; Eccl 1:8). The eye that craves is never filled — a warning against covetousness.
